Introducing Yourself

Screen 1 of 12

Discover the situation

Introducing Yourself

Today you discover useful English for meeting someone.

Découvrez comment saluer quelqu'un et vous présenter.

You listen. You read. You choose. You do not speak.

Vous écoutez, vous lisez et vous choisissez. Vous ne parlez pas.

In this step you meet:

  • three greetings;
  • a name and a country;
  • two questions;
  • one polite phrase.

Listen many times. There is no test and no score.

Écoutez autant de fois que vous voulez. Il n'y a ni examen ni note.

Screen 2 of 12

A real situation

Two women meet at a training session

They are in the same English class. They speak.

Deux femmes se rencontrent dans un cours d'anglais.

"Hello. My name is Sarah."

"Hi. I'm Leila."

Is this their first meeting?

Est-ce leur première rencontre ?

Screen 3 of 12

Meet Sarah and Leila

Listen to the two people

Listen first. Then show the text.

Écoutez d'abord. Vous pouvez afficher le texte ensuite.

  • S SarahHello. My name is Sarah.
  • L LeilaHi. I'm Leila.

What are their names?

Screen 4 of 12

Greetings

Three ways to say hello

Listen to one. Then listen to the next one.

Écoutez une expression, puis passez à la suivante.

"Hello."

Good at any time. In a class or at work.

Bonjour. À tout moment.

"Hi."

Friendly and short. With a colleague or a neighbour.

Salut. Plus familier.

"Good morning."

Before 12 o'clock. A little more formal.

Bonjour (le matin). Un peu plus formel.

All three are correct. You choose.

Les trois sont corrects. C'est vous qui choisissez.

Screen 5 of 12

Saying a name

Two ways to say your name

Look at the yellow word. It is the name.

Le mot en jaune est le prénom.

"My name is Sarah."

Je m'appelle Sarah.

"I'm Leila."

Shorter. Same meaning.

Je suis Leila. Plus court, même sens.

Who says this? Choose the person.

Qui dit cette phrase ? Choisissez la personne.

"My name is Sarah."
"I'm Leila."

Screen 6 of 12

Asking a name

"What's your name?"

Listen to the question and the answer.

Cette question demande le prénom.

  • S SarahWhat's your name?
  • L LeilaI'm Leila.

What does this question ask?

"What's" = "What is". « What's » est la forme courte de « What is ».

Screen 7 of 12

Saying a country

"I'm from …"

Three people. Three countries. Listen to each person.

Trois personnes, trois pays. Écoutez chaque personne.

Sarah

"I'm from France."

Leila

"I'm from Egypt."

Amina

"I'm from Morocco."

Match the country and the person.

Associez chaque pays à la bonne personne.

France
Egypt
Morocco

Screen 8 of 12

Asking a country

"Where are you from?"

Listen. Then choose the country.

Écoutez, puis choisissez le pays.

  • L LeilaWhere are you from?
  • S SarahI'm from France.

Which country?

Two questions now: "What's your name?" and "Where are you from?"

Vous connaissez maintenant deux questions.

Screen 9 of 12

A polite phrase

"Nice to meet you."

One person says it. The other person answers.

Une personne le dit, l'autre répond.

  • S SarahNice to meet you.
  • L LeilaNice to meet you, too.

When do you say this?

"too" = "me also". « too » veut dire « moi aussi ».

Screen 10 of 12

The complete conversation

Sarah meets Leila

Now you hear everything together. Listen to all of it, or listen to one line.

Écoutez toute la conversation, ou une phrase à la fois.

  • S SarahHello. My name is Sarah. What's your name?
  • L LeilaHi. I'm Leila.
  • S SarahWhere are you from?
  • L LeilaI'm from Egypt.
  • S SarahNice to meet you.
  • L LeilaNice to meet you, too.

This is the conversation. Only six lines. You know all of them now.

Six phrases seulement. Vous les connaissez toutes.

Screen 11 of 12

Check the situation

Match the job and the phrase

Each phrase has a job. Choose the correct phrase. You can try again.

Chaque phrase a un rôle. Choisissez la bonne phrase. Vous pouvez réessayer.

Say hello Saluer
Say a name Donner un prénom
Say a country Dire un pays
Be polite Être poli(e)

Screen 12 of 12

Step complete

You discovered useful language for meeting someone

Good work. Here is your English from today.

Voici les expressions découvertes aujourd'hui.

  • "Hello." · "Hi." · "Good morning." Bonjour.
  • "My name is Sarah." · "I'm Leila." Je m'appelle… / Je suis…
  • "What's your name?" Comment vous appelez-vous ?
  • "I'm from France." Je viens de France.
  • "Where are you from?" D'où venez-vous ?
  • "Nice to meet you." · "Nice to meet you, too." Enchanté(e).

All together: "Hello. My name is Sarah. I'm from France. Nice to meet you."

Vous pouvez utiliser toutes ces phrases ensemble.
